segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Sells Cisco networking, security, collaboration and observability products and lifecycle services to businesses, governments and service providers across the Americas.
segments.evidence: Our business is organized into the following three geographic segments: Americas; Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA); and Asia Pacific, Japan, and China (APJC).

revenueModel.text: Businesses, public institutions, governments and service providers pay Cisco for hardware, software, SaaS offerings and lifecycle services such as technical support and professional services.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to our product offerings, we provide a broad range of services over the lifecycle of our products, including technical support services and professional services.
